name: NA Stadium Series - Cleveland 2023
information:
We are happy to announce the second competition in the North American Stadium Series! Our second stop is the beautiful lake front FirstEnergy Stadium. This competition will offer a very unique experience for speedcubers and football fans alike. You won't want to miss it! Please see below and other tabs for very important information.
